status.en: 48 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 25% fewer than the week before, most of them in Tehran, Gulf Of Oman and Minab.
status.nb: 48 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 25 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Teheran, Omanbukta og Minab.

summary.en: The United States struck Iran's Qeshm Island, prompting Iran to warn it would reopen the Strait of Hormuz within two days if U.S. conditions are met. South Korea is expanding naval and anti-piracy operations closer to the Strait of Hormuz to keep it open. The United States has sanctioned Indian and Turkish firms accused of helping Iran, while Russia has deepened support for Iran with a missile launcher deal. A Chinese bank is facilitating Iranian and Russian money flows. 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
